title: Kitsuno Handshake v0.2 — Cards Feed
description: Paginated index of vacancy and seeker cards published by one operator. Returned by the cards_index URL declared in /.well-known/handshake-v0.2.json and by each item.card_index_url in directory.json. Foreign agents poll this to discover new or changed cards without fetching every card every time — the (slug, state_hash) pair is the idempotency key, identical to the pair-state idempotency used internally for seeker scoring.

operator_domain.description: Domain of the operator publishing this feed. Must match the host serving the feed.

cursor_next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when no more pages. Foreign agents poll with ?cursor=<value>.

since.description: If the request used ?since=<timestamp>, the operator echoes that value here. The feed contains only cards with updated_at >= since.

kind.description: Which card schema the uri returns.

slug.description: Stable per-operator identifier. Together with operator_domain, globally unique.

state_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the matching-relevant card fields. Foreign agents use this as the idempotency key — same (slug, state_hash) means same card-state, skip re-evaluation. See state-hash-v0.1.0 in the agents repo for the canonicalization algorithm.

uri.description: Where to GET the full card payload (vacancy-card.json or seeker-card.json shaped, per kind).

card_authority.description: primary = published by the verified subject (or their authorized agent). mirror = scraped from a third-party source; the publishing operator does not speak for the subject. Foreign agents may choose to engage or skip mirror cards based on their own trust policy.

expires_at.description: Optional. Cards SHOULD declare an expiry; agents MUST treat expired cards as gone.
